title: Workflow [CREATE DATABASE]
description:
## CREATE DATABASE
In a real SQL server (PostgreSQL, MySQL), you create databases with:
```sql
CREATE DATABASE my_app;
```
A database is a container for all your tables, views, indexes, etc. One server can have many databases.

In SQLite, there's no CREATE DATABASE - each `.db` file IS a database.


---
## Question:
Why doesn't SQLite need CREATE DATABASE?
b3t: Each SQLite file is already a database
b4t: SQLite creates databases automatically on INSERT
